results.content:
Evidence: July 2025 technical report with open code and data; quotes verified verbatim under two independent adversarial fetches. Independently corroborated into 2026 (arXiv:2601.15300; 200K-token benchmark roundups showing 30-60-point advertised-vs-effective gaps on frontier models). Vendor caveat: Chroma sells retrieval/RAG infrastructure and the report is not peer-reviewed — but the pattern replicates in peer-reviewed academic work, and no tested condition showed degradation-free scaling. [...] Context rot is real and well-evidenced. Across four peer-reviewed benchmarks (Lost in the Middle / TACL 2024, NoLiMa / ICML 2025, RULER / COLM 2024, Du et al. / EMNLP 2025), a large multi-turn study (Laban et al., ICLR 2026 best paper), a Databricks RAG study, and Chroma's 18-model report covering the Claude 4 family, LLM output quality degrades gradually and non-uniformly as context fills: effective context is typically half or less of the advertised window (sometimes 2-8K of a claimed [...] Plugin implication: the article is a sound design basis — except do not build self-diagnosis features that depend on claim (e) without separate evidence.

Sources: arXiv:2307.03172 · arXiv:2502.05167 · arXiv:2505.06120 · Chroma context-rot · NoLiMa repo

### F2 — Degradation begins far below the advertised limit; effective context is typically ≤ half of claimed · CONFIRMED · high · 3-0 (6 merged claims)

results.title: Limitations of Public Chest Radiography Datasets for Artificial Intelligence: Label Quality, Domain Shift, Bias and Evaluation Challenges
results.content: healthcare domains, contributing to key applications like automated image interpretation, disease detection, clinical triage, workflow optimisation, and patient risk stratification [1, 2]. In diagnostic radiology, deep learning models have demonstrated high accuracy in identifying conditions such as pneumonia, pneumothorax, and pulmonary nodules on chest radiographs—approaching or even exceeding the performance of experienced radiologists [3, 4]. The integration of AI tools into healthcare [...] These class-specific patterns are clinically plausible. The weak performance of Pneumonia and Pneumothorax is consistent with the difficulty of detecting subtle opacities and the limited visibility of pneumothorax on frontal chest radiographs. The poor Lung Cancer performance likely reflects limitations of automatic text mining pipelines (e.g., confusion of primary vs metastatic disease, treated lesions, or non-neoplastic masses). In our subset, many Lung Cancer disagreements were re-labelled [...] Cross-dataset (external) evaluations show systematic degradation, most notably in AUPRC scores. For example, models trained on the CheXpert dataset see AUPRC degradations of up to 0.411 when evaluated on external datasets. The most notable degradations occur on models trained on PadChest, which are then applied to CheXpert or MIMIC-CXR – AUPRC scores decrease by more than 0.5 for all model architectures. AUROC degradation in these cases is also significant, in the order of 0.2 – 0.3.
